title: Finalize and revalidate source-bound evidence before PR review
outOfScope: Release publication, tags, release-state identity, and provider assets.
Modification of archived evidence or source code from failed PRs #514, #515, #517, and #518.

sources.reason: Hosted template-smoke for PR #518 proves source-bound Capability Truth evidence can become stale after local PR validation.
The local final PR gate currently omits current source-bound evidence validation.
Canonical Japanese assessment generator and validator.

riskAssessment.reason: The corrective changes final PR and finish evidence boundaries, but does not publish a release or weaken any gate.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized continuous corrective delivery, PR merge, closure, and cleanup.

preReviewWarnings: Use one composite final evidence gate rather than duplicating hash logic in multiple callers.
The final PR gate must validate after formatting and before PR ownership acceptance.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A canonical source-bound evidence gate validates Capability Truth, Japanese assessment, and documentation-alignment artifacts against current sources.
ai-finish runs the canonical final evidence gate before Outcome generation or archive.
check-ai-pr runs the same gate after formatting and before PR ownership acceptance.
Focused regressions prove stale source-bound evidence fails both finish and PR validation, while regenerated evidence passes.
The installed Makefile exposes the same gate and runtime-parity coverage proves it.
Focused checks and hosted CI pass before merge.
guidelines: Use existing canonical validators; do not reimplement their digest logic.
Generated evidence is regenerated only by its supported commands, never hand-edited.
Fail closed on stale evidence and preserve all existing release gates.
Keep the corrective as one Work Item and one PR from current main.

intent.problem: PR #518 changed a test after Capability Truth evidence generation; check-ai-pr did not revalidate the source-bound artifact, so hosted full quality was the first failure detector.
constraints: Start from the merged #513 mainline, not any failed stacked branch.
Retain failed PRs as immutable audit evidence.
Use focused local checks under the temporary user efficiency exception; hosted CI remains mandatory.
Do not claim publication or modify release identity.
intent.rationale: A single final evidence gate shared by ai-finish, check-ai-pr, and installed runtime prevents the same ordering defect from recurring across Capability Truth, Japanese assessment, and documentation alignment.
